posts.title: Resolving Naver Map Open API Authentication Failure (200): Changing ncpClientId to ncpKeyId
posts.description: This post summarizes the cause of the Authentication Failed (200) error in the Naver Map Open API. It covers how console integration changed ncpClientId, govClientId, and finClientId to ncpKeyId, as well as the web service URL registration rules that require excluding the port and URI.

posts.title: Mac Office Activation Guide | Install LTSC with Volume License VL Serializer
posts.description: A step-by-step guide to installing and activating Microsoft Office on Mac using a volume license. Covers LTSC installer selection, VL Serializer application, and activation verification.

posts.title: HTTPS TLS/SSL Free vs Paid Certificates
posts.description: Compare TLS/SSL certificate issuance flows across free (ACME/Let's Encrypt), paid, and cloud-managed options, and design renewal automation plus termination point minimization to reduce cost and operational risk.

posts.title: How to Create an Oracle Cloud Always Free A1 Instance - Public IP Connection and SSH Security Setup
posts.description: A step-by-step guide to creating an Oracle Cloud Always Free A1 (ARM) instance. Covers everything from selecting the free spec to connecting a public IP, setting up an SSH key, and restricting SSH port 22 with a VCN Security List and NSG.

posts.title: Building a Hugo Blog - From Start to SEO
posts.description: A step-by-step guide to building a blog with Notion→Hugo→GitHub Pages, connecting a custom domain, adding multilingual support, and applying security headers.

posts.title: Cloudflare Workers Static Site Guide - From Deployment to SEO
posts.description: Putting a static site on Cloudflare, then layering code in front of it to improve SEO. A signpost for a four-part series.

posts.title: How to Use wrangler - Local Development and Deployment for Cloudflare Workers
posts.description: Installing wrangler and setting up types, booting workerd with wrangler dev, and deploying. Starting with the fact that wrangler dev is not a frontend dev server.

posts.title: How to Set Up Caching in Cloudflare Workers - Edge Cache and Tiered Cache
posts.description: Two ways to cache when a Worker calls an external API, and the three traps you will definitely hit if you don't know about them. Per-data-center cache, Tiered Cache, and cache keys.

posts.title: 공공데이터포털 API 400 오류 - 헤더에 environment 가 있으면 거부한다
posts.description: INVALID_REQUEST_PARAMETER_ERROR 는 파라미터 문제가 아닐 수 있다. data.go.kr 은 헤더 값의 environment= 을 거부한다.

posts.title: How to fix missing TortoiseGit icon overlays on Windows
posts.description: When Windows Explorer hides TortoiseGit status icons, check the ShellIconOverlayIdentifiers limit and priority. Clean up the registry and restart Explorer to bring the overlays back instantly.

posts.title: Building a Blog with Hugo + GitHub
posts.description: A walkthrough of building a personal blog using the Notion → Markdown conversion → Hugo build → GitHub Pages deployment flow. Follow along with Hugo installation, applying the m10c theme, automated deployment with GitHub Actions, and baseURL configuration pitfalls to reduce deployment errors.
